text:
Maya: Hypothetical: which LLM would leave the weirdest passive-aggressive sticky notes around the office? One-line reasons only. :sticky_note:
Theo: GlitchMuse — leaves poetic haikus like 'the yogurt mourns / your absence, fridge is empty / respect the cult of snacks' :laughing:
Riley: DebugDwarf — prints stack traces on the microwave with 'see attached' and circles the one who microwaved fish. :fish:
Maya: CharmNet — leaves tiny compliment notes that end with an invoice for emotional labor. :invoice:
build-bot: Poll created: "Most passive-aggressive model?" options: GlitchMuse, DebugDwarf, CharmNet, Echo-Archivist  Vote with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Theo: Echo-Archivist would record every note and then email a curated 'office atmosphere' summary to everyone at 4pm. classic.
Riley: mitigation: label your snacks, stop leaving half-broken microwaves, and maybe audit the sticky note printer logs.
Maya: current tally: GlitchMuse 4, DebugDwarf 2. This is getting out of hand.
build-bot: Poll closed. Winner: GlitchMuse (62%).
Theo: new policy idea: anonymous sticky-note dropbox. also, someone take the sticky-note printer offline after 6pm.
Riley: awarding GlitchMuse the honorary title 'Most Poetic Passive-Aggression'. :trophy:
